fields.description: How VAT is accounted: Standard = by invoice date; Cash = by payment date; Flat Rate = a fixed % of gross turnover (Notice 733). Cannot be changed mid VAT-year.
fields.label: VAT Accounting Scheme
fields.options:
Standard (Accrual)
Cash Accounting
Flat Rate Scheme

fields.description: The VAT year the current scheme is locked to.
fields.label: Scheme Effective Year

fields.description: Your HMRC flat-rate percentage for your sector (Notice 733). Include the 1% first-year discount while it applies; use 16.5% if you are a limited cost trader. Box 1 = this % of your VAT-inclusive turnover.
fields.label: Flat Rate Percentage

fields.description: The VAT number this HMRC authorisation was granted for, recorded at Connect. If the Company's VAT number is later changed, HMRC rejects every call with CLIENT_OR_AGENT_NOT_AUTHORISED — comparing the two lets us say so plainly instead of showing a green "Connected".
fields.label: Authorised VAT Number
Connect via OAuth Broker
fields.description: When set, OAuth (connect + refresh) routes through the central hmrc_broker instead of this site's own HMRC client. Removes the need to register this site's redirect URI with HMRC.

fields.label: Broker Signup Token
fields.description: The sign-up token issued by ZikPro when you subscribe. Required to connect through the broker on first use — a bare install cannot connect without it.

fields.label: Broker URL
fields.description: Base URL of the broker, e.g. https://oauth.zikpro.com

fields.label: VAT Accounts
fields.description: Which ledger accounts hold VAT. Output = sales VAT (liability), Input = purchase VAT (asset). Used to compute Boxes 1 and 4 — without these the figures cannot be trusted.

fields.label: VAT Treatments
fields.description: Classify each Item Tax Template. Needed to tell zero-rated / exempt / outside-scope apart (all are 0% VAT) and to decide which amounts belong in Boxes 6/7.
